mismatches: List[str] = [] for sku_id in normalized_ids: sku = _fetch_sku_document(sku_id) sku_plant = str(sku.get("prodPlant", "")).strip() if not sku_plant: raise ValueError(f"SKU {sku_id} does not have a prodPlant value in the Enumeration API") if sku_plant != plant_id: mismatches.append(f"{sku_id} ({sku_plant})")
if mismatches: raise ValueError( "All skuIds on a scheduling job must belong to the same plant as plantId. " f"Plant {plant_id} did not match: {', '.join(mismatches)}" )
return normalized_ids
